title: Scoped tracing capture misses events while only one dispatcher is registered
description: A log-capturing test using tracing::subscriber::with_default passed alone and captured nothing when the other tests in the binary ran in parallel. In tracing-core 0.1.36, while at most one dispatcher is registered, Dispatchers::rebuilder() takes the JustOne path and asks only the registering thread's default; another test thread without a subscriber that reaches the same callsite first caches interest `never`, so the event is skipped on every thread. Keep a second dispatcher alive while capturing (has_just_one becomes false) so interest is computed across every registered dispatcher.
whenToUse: Tests that assert on log output through a scoped subscriber in a binary whose other tests emit through the same callsites.
whenNotToUse: A test binary with a global subscriber, or a capturing test that runs alone.
